Package implementations

Class MyArrayList

java.lang.Object
implementations.MyArrayList
All Implemented Interfaces:
ListADT
public class MyArrayList extends Object implements ListADT
A dynamic array-based implementation of the ListADT interface, for use in CPRG 304 at SAIT.

This class stores String elements in an internally managed array that grows automatically when capacity is reached. The growth amount is determined by a configurable growth rate expressed as a decimal percentage of the current array length (e.g., 0.25 means 25% growth). All index parameters are zero-based unless otherwise noted.

Design Note – String-Specific Implementation:
This class is intentionally designed to store String elements only. A fully reusable, type-safe design would use Java generics (e.g., MyArrayList<E>), allowing any object type to be stored in the list. Generic programming is outside the scope of CPRG 304 and has therefore been omitted. All element fields, parameters, and return types are fixed as String throughout this class and its implementations.
